lists.name: Albums as Described by Spongebob Squarepants quotes

podcast.body: Released in 1998, this was Creed's first album. It initially found sales success in Christian record stores before breaking through to sell millions of records in the mainstream. The album's commercial performance sparked extensive debate regarding the band's spirituality. Its success was significantly bolstered by the "Christian underground." "Creed from their first album, 1998's My Own Prison."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
